The main takeaway from our work is that

a single Ti:Sa laser can be used to acquire CARS, SHG and TPF images in both forward- and backward-scattering geometries with a single excitation wavelength, and that the spectral resolution of the CARS microscope can be adjusted to the desired range by controlling the time delay between CARS pump and Stokes.
simultaneous hyperspectral D-CARS, SHG and TPF imaging is feasible using a single Ti:Sa laser, with a single objective lens and with only passive optics.
